_README: Business details. Edit, then run: python3 build.py. Values in [square brackets] are unknown: they are hidden from the public pages and left out of the structured data until filled in. The public address is deliberately just Newquay, Cornwall (drop-off by arrangement). Prices live in data/prices.json, FAQs in data/faqs.json, areas in data/areas.json, services in data/services.json, page text in content/pages/.
tagline: Clothing alterations, repairs & curtain shortening in Newquay, Cornwall
_form_action_note: FormSubmit forwards enquiries to the email with no backend. The FIRST submission triggers a one-time activation email to that inbox, which must be clicked before messages are delivered. After activation FormSubmit offers a random alias URL you can paste here to hide the address.

people.name: Sylvia Pauline Tippett
people.bio: Sylvia has more than 50 years' experience as a tailor. She was a tailor at RAF St Mawgan, working for the military for over 50 years, where uniforms had to be precise, hard-wearing and immaculately finished, every single time.

people.name: Maxine Jennings
people.bio: Maxine is Sylvia's daughter. She has more than three years' experience working alongside her mum, learning the tailoring skills and standards Sylvia built over half a century.

dropoff_note: Drop-off by arrangement. Call or message Maxine to arrange a time.

geo._note: Town-centre coordinates for Newquay (not a street address).

launderama._note: Friendly referral shown in the 'washed first' FAQ, the prices page 'Clean items only' note and the curtains page 'Good to know' card. Facts from newquaylaunderama.com (service washes, duvet cleaning & large item washing).
launderama.name: Newquay Launderama
launderama.before: No washing machine big enough for your curtains? Our friends at
launderama.after: offer service washes and large-item washing, so they can get them clean for you first.
